description: Utentes com Comportamentos Aditivos e Dependências is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SICAD. Monitoring the clinical movement of users with problems of addictive behaviors and dependencies. New users: Registered users with problems related to the use of psychoactive substances who first used the outpatient facilities of the public treatment network (first requests for treatment). Coverage: SICAD. The portal shows the English title as "Users with Additive Behaviors and Dependencies" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is SICAD. Its keywords include transparencia-sns-gov-pt, dependencias, comportamentos-aditivos, saude-dos-portugueses, substancias. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, JSON. The listing shows 2023-06-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
